programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = grid[0].index(2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        if r <= center:
            for c in (center - r, center + r):
                if 0 <= c < n:
                    out[r][c] = 2
        for c in range(n):
            d = c - center
            if abs(d) < r and (d - r) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
